proposed_widenings.name: SpawnedCreaturePayload.catalog_ref
proposed_widenings.justification: Most figurine variants name an existing creature stat block rather than shipping an inline stat block. The current magic-item spawned-creature surface only accepts an inline `statBlock`, so the collection cannot be authored honestly without either duplicating off-screen monster data or inventing placeholders.
proposed_widenings.evidence: This bronze statuette is of a griffon rampant. It can become a Griffon ... / These gold statuettes of lions ... Each can become a Lion ...

proposed_widenings.name: spend_resource_over_time
proposed_widenings.justification: Goat of Traveling spends charges as elapsed time passes in creature form, then automatically reverts when the pool is empty. The current surface has reset cadences and elapsed-time passive triggers, but no atom or resource operation that decrements a charge pool per hour while an effect remains active.
proposed_widenings.evidence: It has 24 charges, and each hour or portion thereof it spends in goat form costs 1 charge. When it runs out of charges, it reverts to a figurine ...

proposed_widenings.name: probabilistic_override
proposed_widenings.justification: Obsidian Steed has a per-use random chance to ignore commands, including reversion commands, with a further random-transport consequence if mounted. That is not an attack roll, save gate, ability check, or existing random-table branch that can be attached to companion obedience state.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The figurine has a 10 percent chance each time you use it to ignore your orders, including a command to revert to figurine form.

proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemVariant.bundle_members
proposed_widenings.justification: Golden Lions and Ivory Goats are packaged as multiple figurines with independent use/recharge behavior inside one named line. The current collection-variant shape models one payload per variant, not a closed bundle of sibling items that can be used one-at-a-time or simultaneously.
proposed_widenings.evidence: These gold statuettes of lions are always created in pairs. You can use one figurine or both simultaneously. / These ivory statuettes of goats are always created in sets of three.

notes: Stopped before authoring content. The current `magic_item` collection and `spawned_creature` family cover the simple summon/revert/cooldown core, but the full SRD collection still needs catalog-ref creature sourcing plus new mechanics for time-based charge drain and probabilistic command override.
